arguments.code:
import re, json
ex=json.load(open('input.json'))['examples']
p=r'[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{3}(-R)?'
for e in ex:
    m=bool(re.fullmatch(p,e['text']))
    print(e['text'], m, e['matches'], m==e['matches'])
